`priority:*` and `type` are ⛔ deliberately withheld. SKILL.md: 「skills 车道 finding 由该席自分诊,全仓轮跳过」 — the skills lane grades its own findings, so this seat produces the lane and stops there. `finding` stays on until that lane grades it, per 「`finding` 恒 = 待首次定级、定级即离标」.
